note: Standard JSON has no NaN/Infinity literal, so this is the one unrepresentable/ fixture whose "value" field uses the {"$float": "NaN"|"Infinity"|"-Infinity"} sentinel object in place of an ordinary JSON number for the Float child (Sec 5.9.0). A NonFiniteFloat Value can only be constructed directly through a binding's API: Sec 5.2 rule 14 never classifies a parsed literal as a non-finite Float, so no .ktav input can produce this case.
